title: Derived tensor augmentation on a scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $A,I,B$ be objects of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], with $\beta:B\to A$. Say that $\beta$ is a derived tensor augmentation with factor $I$ if there are K-flat complexes $P,J$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], isomorphisms $a:Q(P)\cong A$, $i:Q(J)\cong I$ and $b:Q(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes J))\cong B$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and a map of complexes $u:J\to\mathcal O_X[0]$, such that $\beta=a\circ Q(\rho_P)\circ Q(1_P\otimes u)\circ b^{-1}$, where $\rho_P:\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes\mathcal O_X[0])\cong P$ the canonical right unitor. Here $Q$ sends a complex to the derived category. The tensor is the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and its additive monoidal structure is supplied by [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Thus $B$ represents $A\otimes^{\mathbf L}I$ and $\beta$ is induced by the derived morphism $I\to\mathcal O_X$ represented by $u$.
